}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== {{See also|List of SBCs|Banana Pi BPI R4 (WiFi 7)}}
===Specifications=== :;Banana Pi RPI R4 board *CPU: [[MediaTek]] MT7987AV (''Filogic 850'') :Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A53) @2.0GHz *System Memory: 2GB (DDR4) RAM *Storage: 8GB (eMMC), 256MB (SPI NAND) Flash, :32MB (NOR) Flash, MicroSD Card slot *Networking: 4x GbE (RJ45) ports (LAN) :1x 2.5GbE (RJ45) port (WAN), 1x 2.5GbE SFP cage *USB: 1x USB 3.2 (Host) port *Expansion: M.2 (Key-B) slot w/ USB 3.0 interface :for 5G or 4G LTE connectivity + 3x nanoSIM slots :1x Mini PCIe slot w/ 2-lane PCIe 3.0 for [[Banana Pi BPI-R4-NIC-BE14|Wi-Fi 7]] NIC :1x Mini PCIe slot w/ USB 2.0 interface :1x 16-pin MikroBus GPIO header *Power Supply: 12V/5.2A via DC jack or 2-pin connector, :20V via USB Type-C PD port or :Optional PoE module (RT5400) for 2.5GbE (RJ45) port
